column4: dialect-gated: cmd/cleat-worker/a_drop_waits_for_a_resume_and_for_a_second_drop_test.go's SQL Server arm needs CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, which this job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) does not supply. The PostgreSQL arm runs here. Measured 2026-10-30: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run 'TestADropWaits|TestATenantIsDropped' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports this test and TestATenantIsDroppedOnSQLServer, each ledgered.

dialect-gated: auth/a_dropped_id_cannot_be_recreated_by_a_racing_create_test.go's SQL Server arm needs CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, which this job runs ./auth/ without. The PostgreSQL arm runs here. Measured 2026-10-30: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./auth/ -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' lists this test among the other SQL Server arms already ledgered.
